雄狮城（雄狮城（第22页）她径直走到另一侧坐下，低着头，视线落在自己的靴尖上，仿佛那里有什么值得研究的纹路。马车缓缓启动，车轮压过石板路，发出规律的滚动声。车厢内的气氛很微妙。明明只有两个人，空间也并不大，却安静得过分。他们谁都没有说话，但这种沉默，与来时路上那种剑拔弩张的沉默又完全不同。经过了昨晚那场荒唐的闹剧，一些看不见的东西，似乎在他们之间发生了改变。就好像一根无形的线，将两个原本毫无交集的人，以一种尴尬又无法挣脱的方式，捆绑在了一起。缇亚娜能感觉到身旁那个男人的视线，只是平静地落在她身上。她下意识地挺直了背脊，努力维持着自己元帅的仪态，但微微发烫的耳根，却出卖了她内心的不平静。她不明白，为什么自己会容忍这个男人安然地坐在自己的马车里。缇亚娜的思绪又开始乱了。一天的奔波，在这样诡异的沉默中度过。当马车的速度渐渐放缓，外面传来嘈杂的人声时，缇亚娜才从自己的思绪中回过神来。雄狮城，到了。透过车窗的缝隙，德玛西亚王都那标志性的白色城墙映入眼帘。城墙由巨大的白色岩石堆砌而成，高达数十米，墙体上看不到一丝缝隙，浑然一体。每隔一段距离，就有一座高耸的箭塔，塔顶上，绘有双剑交叉的德玛西亚国徽的旗帜，在风中猎猎作响。城门处，守城的士兵身穿全套的精钢铠甲，手持长戟，站得笔直。他们的眼神锐利，警惕地扫视着每一个进城的人。这里是王都，德玛西亚的心脏，任何一丝懈怠都是不被允许的。当他们看到那辆装饰着冕卫家族徽记的马车时，所有士兵的表情都瞬间变得肃穆。一名军官快步上前，在确认了车夫递出的令牌后，立刻单膝跪地，高声喝令：“恭迎缇亚娜元帅回城！”话音落下，城门通道两侧，所有正在接受盘查的平民和商贩被迅速清空。原本肃立的守城士兵们，齐刷刷地单膝跪地，低下了他们高傲的头颅。“恭迎缇亚娜元帅！”整齐划一的呐喊声，在雄狮城高大的门洞里回荡，充满了尊敬与狂热。在德玛西亚，冕卫家族是传奇，而兵马大元帅缇亚娜·冕卫，更是军人们心中不败的战神。马车没有受到任何盘查，在无数士兵的跪拜礼中，畅通无阻地驶入了雄狮城。车厢内，缇亚娜依旧低着头，一言不发。肖恩看着窗外那一片片跪倒的身影，又看了看身旁这个沉默的女人，嘴角的笑意更深了。马车没有驶向王宫，也没有去往军部，而是在宽阔的街道上穿行，径直朝着城中最为显赫的冕卫家族庄园驶去。当那扇雕刻着冕卫家族家徽的巨大铁门在眼前缓缓打开时，缇亚娜终于抬起了头。她看着自己从小长大的地方，眼神复杂。她知道，从马车驶入这扇大门开始，一切都将变得不同。

> Chapter 520 Lion City (Page 1)
Lion City (Page 22) She walked straight to the other side and sat down, lowering her head, her eyes falling on the toes of her boots, as if there were any lines worth studying there. The carriage started slowly, and the wheels passed over the stone road, making a regular rolling sound. The atmosphere in the carriage was very subtle. There were obviously only two people, and the space was not big, but it was too quiet. None of them spoke, but this silence was related to the way they came. The tense silence was completely different. After the ridiculous farce last night, something invisible seemed to have changed between them. It was like an invisible thread, binding the two people who had no connection with each other in an awkward and inescapable way. Tiana could feel the gaze of the man beside her falling on her calmly. She shook her back and tried to maintain her marshal demeanor, but her slightly hot ears betrayed her inner peace. She didn't understand why she allowed this man to sit peacefully in her carriage. Tiana's thoughts began to become chaotic again. After a day of running, Tiana spent her time in such an eerie silence. When the carriage gradually slowed down and noisy voices came from outside, Tiana stopped from her thoughts. I came back to my senses. The Lion City has arrived. Through the gap in the car window, the iconic white city wall of the capital of Demacia comes into view. The city wall is made of huge white rocks, and there is no gap in the wall. Every once in a while, there is a towering arrow tower. On the top of the tower, a flag with the national emblem of Demacia crossed is flapping in the wind. The soldiers were wearing full sets of fine steel armor, holding halberds, and stood upright. Their eyes were sharp, scanning everyone who entered the city. This is the capital, the heart of Demacia, and no slack is allowed. When they saw the carriage decorated with the emblem of the Crown Guard family, the expressions of all the soldiers suddenly became solemn. An officer stepped forward quickly and confirmed the token handed out by the driver. After that, he immediately knelt down on one knee and shouted loudly: "Welcome Marshal Tiana back to the city!" After the words fell, all the civilians and vendors who were being questioned on both sides of the city gate passage were quickly cleared away from the city guards who were standing there. The soldiers all knelt down on one knee and lowered their proud heads. "Welcome to Marshal Tiana!" The uniform shouts echoed in the tall door of Lion City, full of respect and enthusiasm. In Demacia, the Crownguard family is legendary, and the military commander Tiana Crownguard is the undefeated God of War in the hearts of the soldiers. The carriage drove into the Lion City unimpeded as countless soldiers knelt down. In the carriage, Tiana still lowered her head and said nothing. Sean looked at the kneeling figures outside the window, and then looked at the silent woman beside him, with a deeper smile. The carriage did not drive to the palace, nor to the military headquarters, but passed through the wide streets and headed straight for the most prominent Crownguard family estate in the city. When the huge iron door engraved with the Crownguard family emblem slowly opened in front of her, she looked at the place where she grew up with complicated eyes.
